The '''CZX-4 sniper rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
